accueil.titre: Get your contracts signed with confidence
accueil.intro: Upload your PDF or Word document, place the signature fields exactly where they belong, and let each signer sign by hand or by typing, from their phone. The final document is sealed, timestamped and verifiable by anyone.

accueil.demo.titre: Demo: a contract signed end to end
accueil.demo.intro: A real two-page contract, prepared in the portal, signed by hand then by typing, then sealed. The video was recorded by our end-to-end test: it only shows what was verified.
accueil.demo.indisponible: The demo video is not available on this server. The steps below describe its content.
accueil.etape.preparer.texte: Create an envelope: a reference, a deadline, the document (PDF or Word, converted to PDF/A) and the signers, in order or in parallel.
accueil.etape.placer.texte: The document is shown page by page: tap where you want a signature, initials, a date or a checkbox, then send.
accueil.etape.signer.texte: Each signer gets a personal link, consents, reads the document and signs by drawing or typing their name, on phone or computer.
accueil.etape.prouver.texte: The final document is sealed (PAdES-B-LTA) and timestamped (RFC 3161). A completion certificate and an evidence package come with every envelope.
accueil.atout.manuscrite.texte: With a finger, stylus or mouse, or by typing: signature and initials land in their fields.
accueil.atout.documents.texte: A Word document is converted to PDF/A on upload; every file is scanned by the antivirus.
accueil.atout.ordre.texte: Signers in order or in parallel; each is invited only when it is their turn.
accueil.atout.cachet.texte: PAdES-B-LTA seal and RFC 3161 timestamp: any change after signing shows.
accueil.atout.preuve.texte: Chained log, completion certificate, evidence package: verifiable outside the platform.
accueil.atout.integration.texte: Documented REST API, Java, TypeScript and .NET SDKs, signing embedded in your own page, signed webhooks.
accueil.atout.isolation.texte: Each organization only sees its own data, isolated down to the database.
accueil.atout.accessibilite.texte: Designed for WCAG 2.2 AA and SGQRI 008 3.0: keyboard, screen readers, phones.
accueil.appel.texte: Create your organization's space, then invite your preparers.
accueil.avis: Demo: the seal and timestamp certificates come from a demonstration authority, not recognised by PDF readers; the data shown is fictitious.
